prompt:
TASK:
Create a production-ready separated character-parts sheet for a cozy mobile game: the character below taken apart into its pieces, each piece drawn alone.
Take apart the EXACT character in the attached image: same colours, same face, same clothes, same outline. Do not redesign it.

PROJECT CONTEXT:
Runeforge: Toon RPG weapons, runes and chibi heroes for a top-down adventure.

STYLE:
STYLE LOCK: Simple toon sprites for a cosy top-down adventure game, like a toy diorama.

PRIMARY GOAL: Weapons, runes and small heroes that read at a glance at small sizes. Simple and cute, never realistic.

CORE AESTHETIC: Lineless flat colour blocks with soft rounded edges. Everything looks like a smooth matte toy. Chunky, rounded, few parts. No texture and no small detail.

EDGES: NO OUTLINES. No dark contour line around any shape. Shapes are separated by colour alone.

COLOR: Bright and friendly. Steel (#D6E2EE) blades, wood (#C98A4B) handles, gold (#F7C948) fittings, leather (#8A5236) grips, stone (#8E96A3) runes. Accents: hero blue (#4A90E2), leaf green (#5CC46A), ruby (#F0504A), violet (#9B6BE8). Skin (#FFD7B0).

SHADING: One flat colour per form, one soft darker shade of the same hue on its lower side, one small soft highlight on round tops and gems. Nothing else.

PROPORTION: Weapons are short and chunky with oversized heads and blades. Characters are super chibi, like a round kawaii mascot: the head and body are ONE soft rounded blob, a little wider at the bottom, about as wide as it is tall. No neck, no arms, no legs. Two small round mitten hands float beside the blob, and two small round feet peek out under it. Tiny solid dot eyes and a tiny mouth.

DETAIL LEVEL: Two or three colours per item plus one accent. A gem is a simple round or diamond shape. Rune glyphs are bold simple marks, never letters.

COMPOSITION: One asset category per image. Every asset isolated with generous crop-safe spacing. Weapons stand upright with the grip at the bottom. No background, no ground shadow.

PALETTE:
Paper #FFFFFF (background), Steel #D6E2EE (fill), Steel Shade #9EB2C8 (shade), Wood #C98A4B (fill), Wood Shade #9A6233 (shade), Gold #F7C948 (fill), Gold Shade #D49A24 (shade), Leather #8A5236 (fill), Stone #8E96A3 (fill), Skin #FFD7B0 (fill), Leaf Green #5CC46A (fill), Hero Blue #4A90E2 (fill), Ruby #F0504A (fill), Violet #9B6BE8 (fill)

SHAPE LANGUAGE:
chunky, toy-like, rounded everything, simple silhouettes, characters are round blobs: head and body merged into one soft rounded shape, no arms and no legs: small round floating hands and small round feet, few parts

RENDERING RULES:
- no outlines: flat colour blocks separated by colour alone
- one flat colour per form plus one soft darker shade of the same hue
- one small soft highlight on round tops and gems
- simple shapes, no texture, no small details
- smooth matte toy plastic, like a toy diorama
- weapons stand upright, grip at the bottom
- crisp high-resolution raster
- isolated presentation with large spacing

CHARACTER:
the round blob hero in the attached image

RIG TYPE:
humanoid

SELECTED PARTS:
- body: the whole round blob with the face and the full outfit, no hands, no feet (required)
- front hand: a small round mitten hand, closed, holding nothing (required)
- back hand: a small round mitten hand, closed, holding nothing (required)
- front foot: a small round foot or boot (required)
- back foot: a small round foot or boot (required)
- the battle axe alone, upright, head up (required)

PART RULES (skeleton rig):
Every part is drawn in the SAME view, angle and style as the assembled character, so the parts fit back together. Each part is drawn ONCE, alone, whole and closed, exactly as it looks on the character.
Where one part covers another on the character, draw the covered area too, so each part is whole and has no hole or flat cut.
Hands and feet are drawn whole and round, the same size as on the character.
When a held item is listed as its own part, the hand is an empty closed fist and the item is drawn alone, whole, upright, at its true size.
Every colour on a part is a colour the character has in that same place. Do not add joints, balls, stubs, sockets or skin that the character does not show.
Keep TRUE RELATIVE SIZES, exactly as on the assembled character. Do not enlarge small pieces to fill their cell.

CANVAS AND LAYOUT:
Output size 1024x1024. Solid flat background #00FF00 with no texture, no vignette, no border. Nothing in the picture may use a colour close to the background colour.
The game shows each asset in a 1:1 (width:height) frame. Compose each asset to suit that frame, and keep its natural proportions: do not stretch or squash it.
Parts-sheet layout: a 3-column grid, one part per invisible cell, filled in reading order (left to right, then top to bottom) in EXACTLY the order the parts are listed above. The first listed part is top-left; the last is bottom-right. Do not rearrange for looks.
Large crop-safe gutters between cells. No part touches another. Do not show the assembled character.
No labels, text, numbers, arrows, scene, or decorative filler.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
outlines, dark outlines, black outlines, ink lines, line art, contour lines, sticker outline, realism, realistic anatomy, muscles, 3D render, photoreal, metal reflections, chrome, texture, wood grain, scratches, rivets, fine detail, small detail, lens flare, glow blur, blood, gore, scene background, ground shadow, motion lines, text, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, clutter

FINAL CHECK:
Every listed part is present once, fully separated, whole, in the character's view and colours, at true relative size, and crop-safe, with no added joints, stubs or skin.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS:
Leave a wide empty gap around every part: no part touches or nearly touches another.
